holders.$comment: Holder-tier settings sized for ONDO's 10B supply (the TEL default in config/holder-tiers.default.json is sized for 100B and put ~99.8% of ONDO wallets in one tier). Tier edges are TEL's divided by 10, with the small end split finer. distributionTiers labels are JOIN KEYS into holder-transitions.json / tier-outflows.json / holders-history.json: do not rename once data exists. megaHolderThreshold is 20% of supply (same ratio as TEL). retailThreshold, balanceRanges and concentrationBuckets inherit the defaults.

treasury.$comment: append-treasury-history reads only these supply-reconciliation categories. ONDO has no council or escrow bucket (the TEL default would abort the refresh), and reconcile-supply omits a category whose balance is 0, so the holdings Safes stay out: they can be emptied and would abort the daily refresh.

nightly.$comment: Waivers from the shared nightly job list (config/nightly-jobs.json). Every other applicable job runs nightly; a waiver needs a reason (scripts/lib/nightlyPlan.js).

waivers.staker-balances: ONDO has no staking contract in its config (no StakeChanged contract or Zebec stake program), so there is no staking data set to produce.
